functionalRequirement: User will choose from options including searching for their issue, chatting with customer support, asking the community, emailing customer support, or calling customer support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for users to select from the available support options (search, chat, community, email, call) within 3 clicks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interact with multiple support options, necessitating ease of operation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load all support options within 2 seconds for 95% of user requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response times are essential for user satisfaction when accessing support options.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must ensure that all support options are available 99.9% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies continuous access to support options, requiring high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user data transmitted during chat, email, or call interactions using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user interactions, necessitating data protection.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to grant edit permissions for assets to departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users based on their department affiliation and authorization level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must grant edit permissions to all specified user roles (departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, university users) based on their department affiliation and authorization level for 100% of assets.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive permission management across all user roles and assets.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that edit permissions are granted only to authorized users and cannot be bypassed or altered by unauthorized users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive permission management, requiring strict access control.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow administrators to modify user roles and permissions without requiring system downtime or extensive reconfiguration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for flexible permission management, necessitating ease of modification.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must continue to function and enforce existing permissions even if a permission update fails or encounters an error.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires robust permission management, ensuring system stability during updates.

functionalRequirement: Texts sent to that number will be sent to the API, then the system will reply to the user with the answer as another text message.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and reply to text messages within 5 seconds for 95% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time text interactions, requiring timely responses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process and reply to text messages 99.95% of the time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies continuous service availability for text interactions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all text messages transmitted between the user and the API using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive text data, necessitating encryption.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that the reply text message accurately reflects the API response for 100% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise and correct text replies based on API responses.

functionalRequirement: After adding a transportation route, the user shall be able to retrieve transportation requests from other users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must retrieve and display transportation requests within 3 seconds for 95% of user requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time retrieval of transportation requests, requiring quick response times.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must ensure that transportation requests are retrievable 99.9% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies continuous access to transportation requests, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that transportation requests are only retrievable by authorized users and cannot be altered or accessed by unauthorized users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive transportation data, requiring strict access control.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for users to retrieve transportation requests within 2 clicks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires ease of operation for retrieving transportation requests.

functionalRequirement: The Disputes System shall allow users to create charge back requests, prompting for required information and resulting in printed notifications sent to merchants if proof of disputed transactions is not provided.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow users to create charge back requests with all required information (e.g., transaction details, dispute reason) for 100% of valid cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive charge back request functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Non-repudiation: The system must log and store all charge back requests and merchant notifications in an immutable format to prevent disputes over actions taken.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive financial transactions, requiring accountability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must continue to process charge back requests and send notifications even if a single component fails.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires robust dispute resolution, ensuring system stability during failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process charge back requests and send notifications to merchants within 10 seconds for 95% of cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves timely dispute resolution, requiring quick processing.
